name: Szederkény (Hungary)
description: Two horizontal stripes of white over blue in the ratio 2:1, charged in the upper hoist with a white disc bearing the municipal arms of Szederkény (a blue shield with a bunch of grapes and a white wavy stripe) with blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
